statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail is low because fresh delayed NQ evidence shows a contained overnight range rather than persistent one-way extension.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The principal conditional risk checkpoint is the U.S. cash open, Flash PMI and immediate post-release sequence.
headline: Low Tail despite extreme event and rate stress; the U.S. open and Flash PMI remain the main conditional risk window.
body: Delayed MNQ data around 06:04 UTC showed roughly 31,046 inside a narrow 31,037.5-31,065.25 range. Reuters reported firm Asian technology shares and further oil declines. That combination does not establish repeated failed retracements or persistent near-extreme holding.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hour assessments, Tail was mostly low, briefly reached 27% around the prior U.S. open, then normalized as retracement and mixed structure returned. Stress remained high to extreme throughout most of the window.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain low-Tail in the base case outside the narrow 13:30-15:30 UTC U.S. open/PMI/Fed/EIA sequence. Forecast Tail rises only conditionally if opening direction persists through shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or a coherent second leg.

forecast.analysis: Delayed MNQ was around 31,046 at 06:04 UTC inside a narrow 31,037.5-31,065.25 range. Reuters reports stronger Asian technology shares and falling oil. The observed path is contained rather than persistently one-way, so Tail remains low.
drivers: Delayed MNQ near 31,046 inside a narrow overnight range

forecast.analysis: European pre-open liquidity may widen the overnight range. Tail stays low unless a break holds near an extreme and repeated extensions occur through only shallow retracements.
drivers: Pullback depth remains the main Tail test

forecast.analysis: The European cash open is the first stronger liquidity test. A two-way response keeps Tail low; sustained direction with weak pullbacks and aligned technology breadth would be the escalation condition.
Once Europe is established, rates and oil should provide clearer cross-asset confirmation. Tail remains low unless NQ holds a fresh extreme while retracements repeatedly fail.
U.S. premarket participation begins to increase. Stress rises, but Tail remains low unless pre-open direction becomes unusually efficient and mean reversion is repeatedly denied.
drivers: Flash U.S. PMI later at 13:45 UTC

forecast.analysis: Late-European positioning can amplify swings ahead of the U.S. event cluster. A persistent pre-open build with shallow pullbacks would be the condition for higher Tail.

The U.S. open is approaching and Flash PMI follows shortly after. WATCH-level Tail is conditional on futures already holding an extreme or entering the open with a directional structure that resists retracement.

This hour contains the 13:30 UTC cash open and 13:45 UTC Flash U.S. PMI. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening-auction direction persisting through shallow pullbacks, failed retracements or repeated extension.
drivers: Conditional shallow pullbacks or failed retracements

forecast.analysis: Post-PMI price discovery overlaps Governor Barr at 14:05 UTC and EIA at 14:30 UTC. Elevated Tail requires an observed second directional leg or repeated extension after failed retracements; scheduled events alone are insufficient.

By 15:00 UTC the key test is whether the opening/PMI move has produced two-way discovery. Tail falls to WATCH if meaningful retracements develop; continued one-way efficiency would keep risk elevated.
With the main event cluster aging, Tail eases if cross-assets stabilize and pullbacks deepen. Continued extreme holding with failed retracements would delay normalization.
Late U.S. morning conditions normally reduce event concentration. Tail returns low if price discovery is two-way; persistent extension after several failed pullbacks would be the main exception.
drivers: Repeated extension as the main exception

forecast.analysis: Midday liquidity can be thinner, but the event impulse should be better resolved. Tail remains low unless NQ keeps extending from an extreme without meaningful retracement.
Early afternoon remains a monitoring period for a delayed second leg. Tail stays low if the market rotates around established levels rather than building a fresh one-way path.
drivers: Two-way rotation as the base case
Rates and oil as conditional amplifiers

forecast.analysis: Later afternoon risk is lower in the base case. A fresh trend would need both directional persistence and cross-asset confirmation to lift Tail materially.
Approaching the final two U.S. cash hours, Tail stays low unless a new catalyst triggers sustained extension that holds near session extremes.
Power-hour risk rises modestly, but without an observed one-way setup it remains a stress rather than Tail issue. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the key conditional trigger.
Into the cash close, orderly two-way trade would keep Tail low. A late breakout that holds an extreme with weak retracement would be the primary escalation path.
After the cash close, liquidity shifts to futures-only price discovery. Tail remains low unless the close establishes a persistent directional handoff into the overnight session.
drivers: Range rotation as the base case

forecast.analysis: Early overnight trade is expected to be less event-dense. Tail stays low if price rotates within established ranges and cross-asset signals remain mixed.
Asian-session liquidity begins to deepen. Tail remains low unless a new directional impulse repeatedly extends and fails to retrace.
Through the Asian morning, normal two-way discovery is the base case. A sustained extreme with shallow pullbacks would be the condition for moving above low Tail.
Late Asian trade can set the tone for Europe. Tail remains low unless a directional handoff forms with persistent extension and supportive cross-asset confirmation.
Approaching the next European pre-open, Tail edges slightly higher on transition risk but remains low absent an established one-way path.
drivers: No established one-way path in the base case
